acceptanceCriteriaMapping.note: The authoritative doc has two numbered lists: numbered sections (1-24) and the 'Acceptance Criteria' list (1-20). References here mean the Acceptance Criteria list unless they say 'section'. dailyProofCycleCompletion is ONE controlled cycle demonstrated end to end: Spec 147 -> 145 -> 141 -> 146 -> 144 -> 142/138 -> ADOS execution -> independent Codex reviewer (resolved from the run's own durable implementer id) -> real ADOS run-level completion reflected by the office -> task 'completed' via the existing operator transition (criteria 1-17; office lifecycle section 12). The candidate == validated == reviewed == exact HEAD + Approved-review publication gate is the final leg. The office ExternalProjectAdosExecution schema types its review/validation/publish sub-stage flags as literal false, so the in-office records cannot carry that leg; it is enforced by the production modules (validationPlan.js isFinalValidationSatisfied / validationPolicy.js targetsMatch / reviewConvergence.js computeConvergenceStatus) and exercised by spec148RoleAssignmentEvidence.test.ts, which runs the convergence biconditional over this run's own durable ADOS records in every case, both directions, unconditionally, and additionally over a real-SHA fixture triple (authoritative requirement 23 - the review runtime is a process boundary). Criteria 19-20 are standing per-candidate ADOS gates: ADOS runs the full configured validation set and an independent Codex review against exact candidate HEAD for every candidate. They are met for this candidate only when that real independent Codex review returns Approved at exact HEAD, which cannot be recorded inside the candidate under review; see publicationResult. Push, PR readiness, approval, merge, and remote deletion stay the human-only publication boundary. Never fabricated (section 18).
acceptanceCriteriaMapping.criterion11ExactHeadConvergence: Enforced from the real durable ADOS records (candidate.json / validation-runtime.json / review-runtime.json) by spec148RoleAssignmentEvidence.test.ts: each of candidateMatchesHead / validatedMatchesHead / reviewedMatchesHead is DERIVED with the production comparator (validationPolicy.js targetsMatch) against `git rev-parse HEAD`, defaults false, and the convergence biconditional (computeConvergenceStatus == CONVERGED iff an Approved review is aligned on candidate == validated == reviewed == exact HEAD) runs UNCONDITIONALLY, both directions. Not simulated in-cycle with a hand-built object.
acceptanceCriteriaMapping.criterion19FullValidation: ADOS runs the full configured validation set against exact HEAD for every candidate and writes durable validation-runtime.json; production's validationPlan.js isFinalValidationSatisfied (validationPolicy.js targetsMatch) at the orchestrateCommand.js final-verification stage routes a target mismatch back to fix instead of the human merge gate. For ANY durable validation-runtime.json with status PASS - regardless of whether it aligns to exact HEAD - spec148RoleAssignmentEvidence.test.ts asserts that all six configured commands ran, exited 0, did not time out, and that the worktree was unmutated (head_before == head_after); a stale PASS still carries the complete list, so this is not HEAD-alignment gated. Only status BLOCK (truncated command list) and an absent record escape the completeness assertion; the convergence biconditional still runs in both and refuses to converge. See dailyProofCycleCompletion.fullConfiguredValidationResult.
acceptanceCriteriaMapping.listReferenced: authoritative requirements doc's 'Acceptance Criteria' list (1-20), not its numbered sections (1-24)

dailyProofCycleCompletion.note: ONE controlled cycle demonstrated end to end. The deterministic harness drives Spec 147 -> 145 -> 141 -> 146 -> 144 -> 142/138 -> ADOS execution with the real services; per authoritative requirement 23 the ImplementerRuntimeProvider process spawn is the only injectable adapter. The same test continues past execution: it resolves the independent reviewer from the run's own durable implementer id (Claude -> distinct Codex, via the real roleResolver.js) with no task transition driven off it, then closes the cycle to terminal 'completed' gated ONLY on the real ADOS run-level completion signal (execution.evidence.completed true - distinct from ImplementerRuntimeStatus 'Completed', which means only 'subprocess exited'). Production's deriveExternalProjectAdosRunStatus derives run stage 'Completed', the Spec 144 active-execution count drops to 0, and the task reaches 'completed' through the existing operator updateSelectedBacklogTaskFromInput transition - no autonomous in_progress -> completed path exists or is added, and the E2E test does not simulate a review/convergence result. The candidate == validated == reviewed == exact HEAD + Approved-review publication gate cannot be carried on the in-office ExternalProjectAdosExecution records (schema types those sub-stage flags as literal false); it is enforced by the production modules and exercised over this run's own durable ADOS records by spec148RoleAssignmentEvidence.test.ts. Its state for this candidate is not-converged (see publicationResult). Push, PR readiness, approval, merge, and remote deletion stay the human-only publication boundary.
dailyProofCycleCompletion.source: real ExternalProjectAdosExecutionService outcome + production deriveExternalProjectAdosRunStatus + real roleResolver.js, exercised by AutonomousCompanyOperationsE2E.test.ts 'completes one controlled Project A cycle end to end' (Tests H, X); the exact-HEAD convergence biconditional against durable ADOS state by spec148RoleAssignmentEvidence.test.ts (real reviewConvergence.js / validationPolicy.js)
dailyProofCycleCompletion.adosRunLevelCompletionSignal: execution.evidence.completed (consumed by ProjectAutonomousExecutionPolicyService / ProjectBacklogReadinessPromotionPolicyService / ProjectAutonomousSuggestionPolicyService countActiveExecutions and OfficeProjectPortalController.isActiveExternalProjectAdosExecution)
dailyProofCycleCompletion.officeObservableDiscriminator: Spec 144 policy active-execution count on the probe (autonomyActiveExecutionCount): 1 while the run is in flight, 0 once evidence.completed is true - asserted in Test X
dailyProofCycleCompletion.derivationLayerUnitCheck: deriveExternalProjectAdosRunStatus execution-sourced branch (toExecutionStage) maps the same signal to stage Started vs Completed
dailyProofCycleCompletion.terminalTransitionAuthority: existing operator updateSelectedBacklogTaskFromInput path; no autonomous completion path exists in production and Spec 148 adds none
dailyProofCycleCompletion.convergenceBiconditional: spec148RoleAssignmentEvidence.test.ts asserts, unconditionally and against the real durable ADOS records, that computeConvergenceStatus == CONVERGED iff an Approved review is aligned on candidate == validated == reviewed == exact HEAD; the negative branch pins the specific non-converged status (IN_PROGRESS for a 'Changes Requested' / trailing-SHA review, NOT_STARTED for a clean checkout) and asserts publicationResult stays a standing 'Blocked until ...' gate.
dailyProofCycleCompletion.fullConfiguredValidationResult: ADOS runs the full configured validation set (npm test, npx tsc --noEmit, npm run build, npm run test:e2e:home-canvas, git diff --check, git diff --cached --check) against exact HEAD for every candidate and writes durable .agent-workflow/runs/148-.../validation-runtime.json. A standing gate, re-established per candidate, not a frozen snapshot. For ANY such record with status PASS - not only one naming exact HEAD - spec148RoleAssignmentEvidence.test.ts asserts (never transcribed as a SHA literal) that all six configured commands ran, exited 0, did not time out, and head_before == head_after (worktree unmutated). Dropping the prior HEAD-alignment gate on this completeness assertion only strengthens it (a stale PASS still carries the complete list) and was the exact conditionality the independent review flagged. `validated_sha == git HEAD` stays a derivation input, not an unconditional assertion, because this suite runs as npm test = validation command #1. Two record states escape the completeness assertion, both safe: status BLOCK (a failed attempt, e.g. a host-suspension wall-clock timeout, writes a truncated command list - asserting it would deadlock recovery) and an absent record; the convergence biconditional still runs in both and refuses to converge.

requirementsChainProof.note: Where each link of the authoritative requirements' target chain is demonstrated.

links.-> Spec 145 controlled acceptance: Test C (lands in backlog, never Ready)
links.-> Spec 142/138 development bridge: Test F (exact project/task context, structured requirements file payload, no shell interpolation, no cross-project fallback)
links.-> ADOS -> implementer: Tests E/F and 'completes one controlled Project A cycle end to end' drive the real ExternalProjectAdosExecutionService; durable execution/result/run-status records observable by the office
links.-> independent reviewer: AutonomousCompanyOperationsE2E.test.ts - both the main chain test (immediately after execution) and the end-to-end completion test resolve the reviewer for this run from its OWN implementer id via roleResolver.js to Codex, distinct from the Claude implementer; spec148RoleAssignmentEvidence.test.ts Tests P-W cover distinctness / reviewer-unavailable blocks / no self-review from durable ADOS state.
links.-> validation -> exact HEAD: From durable ADOS state: tools/agent-workflow/spec148RoleAssignmentEvidence.test.ts reads .agent-workflow/runs/148-.../{candidate,validation-runtime,review-runtime}.json, compares candidate/validated/reviewed SHA to `git rev-parse HEAD` with the SAME comparator (validationPolicy.js targetsMatch, reached via validationPlan.js isFinalValidationSatisfied at the orchestrateCommand.js final-verification stage), and runs the convergence biconditional UNCONDITIONALLY - an absent later-stage record derives that leg's match as false (never a skip), and a later-stage record present without its earlier sibling fails. ADOS re-establishes durable validation-runtime.json as a PASS per candidate; for ANY record with status PASS - regardless of HEAD alignment - the test asserts the full six-command configured set ran, exited 0, did not time out, and the worktree was unmutated (a stale PASS still carries the complete list; only BLOCK and absent escape it). NOTE: this suite runs inside `npm test` = validation command #1, so validation-runtime.json naming the current HEAD can only exist after this passes - that `validated_sha == HEAD` leg is a derivation input, not an unconditional assertion, and this constraint is stated, not hidden.
links.-> validation / exact HEAD / publication: Same cycle, final leg. The in-office ExternalProjectAdosExecution records cannot carry these sub-stages (schema literal false) - AutonomousCompanyOperationsE2E.test.ts asserts execution.reviewStarted / publishStarted / githubMutationStarted are false as an unconditional shape check in both run states. The gate runs through the real production modules in spec148RoleAssignmentEvidence.test.ts, which executes the convergence biconditional over this run's durable ADOS records - candidate/validated/reviewed SHA alignment via the production comparator validationPolicy.js targetsMatch against real HEAD, carrying the real durable review decision - unconditionally in both directions, plus a real-SHA fixture triple and its refused variants (authoritative requirement 23: the review runtime is a process boundary, like the implementer spawn). CONVERGED only on an Approved review aligned on candidate == validated == reviewed == exact HEAD; for this candidate the durable review reads 'Changes Requested' while under review, so the gate is not converged (publicationResult). Push / approval / merge / remote deletion stay the human-only publication boundary. See spec148CandidatePublicationGate.
links.-> completion: The real ADOS run reports run-level completion (execution.evidence.completed true), the office derives run stage 'Completed', the Spec 144 active-execution count drops to 0, and the task reaches 'completed' via the existing operator transition - production has no autonomous in_progress -> completed path and Spec 148 adds none. See dailyProofCycleCompletion.

spec148CandidatePublicationGate.note: The final leg of the one demonstrated controlled cycle: review, validation, exact HEAD, publication gate. ADOS runs the full configured validation set and an independent Codex review against exact candidate HEAD for every candidate. This tracked artifact records no publish/merge/deploy verdict because committing it advances HEAD and would immediately stale a frozen verdict - the live per-candidate state lives in the durable .agent-workflow/runs/148-.../{candidate,validation-runtime,review-runtime}.json sources, gated in production by validationPlan.js isFinalValidationSatisfied (validationPolicy.js targetsMatch) at the orchestrateCommand.js final-verification stage and tools/agent-workflow/reviewConvergence.js computeConvergenceStatus. spec148RoleAssignmentEvidence.test.ts exercises the convergence biconditional (candidate == validated == reviewed == exact HEAD + Approved review, both directions) over those durable records in every case, unconditionally, and additionally over a real-SHA fixture triple (authoritative requirement 23: the review runtime is a process boundary). AutonomousCompanyOperationsE2E.test.ts does NOT simulate this leg: it stops the demonstrated cycle at the real ADOS run-level completion signal (execution.evidence.completed) and the operator's terminal 'completed' transition. For this candidate the durable review reads 'Changes Requested' while under review, so the gate is not converged (publicationResult). Push, PR readiness, approval, merge, and remote deletion are the human-only publication boundary and are not performed by the runtime (execution policy; the same boundary Specs 142-147 declare). Spec 148 adds no src/ production code and no production-runtime tools/ code - its only production change is an 18-line self-review/reviewer-availability guard in tools/agent-workflow/roleResolver.js; the new tools/agent-workflow/spec148DurableAlignment.js is a read-only helper imported only by spec148RoleAssignmentEvidence.test.ts (see nonInvocationsVerified).
spec148CandidatePublicationGate.criterion19FullValidation: ADOS runs the full configured validation set against exact HEAD for every candidate (see dailyProofCycleCompletion.fullConfiguredValidationResult). For ANY durable validation-runtime.json with status PASS - not only one naming exact HEAD - spec148RoleAssignmentEvidence.test.ts asserts (derived, never a SHA literal) all six commands ran, exited 0, did not time out, and left the worktree unmutated; only status BLOCK and an absent record escape that assertion.
spec148CandidatePublicationGate.criterion20ApprovedReview: The independent Codex review runs against exact candidate HEAD; computeConvergenceStatus reaches CONVERGED only on an Approved review aligned on candidate == validated == reviewed == exact HEAD (spec148RoleAssignmentEvidence.test.ts, both directions, run unconditionally). Not fabricated here.

shaAlignment.note: Requirement 21 asks for candidate/validated/reviewed SHA 'where available' plus the exact-HEAD result. Two forms are recorded: (1) the LIVE per-candidate values are not transcribed as literals - a SHA for the candidate currently under review is stale the moment this evidence commit lands - they are resolved at validation/review time from durableSources below; (2) COMPLETED cycles are recorded as historical observations in observedCycles below (an already-finished candidate's SHAs are permanent branch history, never stale). Both test suites read durableSources and run the convergence biconditional over them: each of candidateMatchesHead / validatedMatchesHead / reviewedMatchesHead defaults false and is only raised by a present, format-valid, exact-HEAD-aligned record, so an absent record can never authorize CONVERGED. Pipeline order candidate -> validate -> review is a presence rule: a later-stage record present without its earlier sibling fails, not skips. spec148RoleAssignmentEvidence.test.ts runs as validation command #1, so validated_sha === HEAD is a derivation input there (stated, not a hidden guard); on every cycle after the first the durable review still names the prior finished candidate, the derivation yields exactTargetMatch=false, and the assertion is 'must not authorize publication'. The comparator is the production one (validationPolicy.js targetsMatch, reached via validationPlan.js isFinalValidationSatisfied at the orchestrateCommand.js final-verification stage).
shaAlignment.observedCyclesNote: Requirement 21 candidate/validated/reviewed SHA 'where available'. Each entry is a COMPLETED ADOS cycle as observed when this evidence was authored - a historical fact about an already-finished candidate, not a per-candidate verdict frozen ahead of the gate. Every recorded SHA is an ancestor-or-equal of branch HEAD (permanent history). spec148RoleAssignmentEvidence.test.ts enforces the 40-hex + ancestor-or-equal shape and, whenever the durable review-runtime.json still names a recorded SHA, that its decision matches the recorded one - so these rows cannot be hand-forged to claim an outcome the durable record contradicts.

observedCycles.fullConfiguredValidation: PASS - npm test, npx tsc --noEmit, npm run build, npm run test:e2e:home-canvas, git diff --check, git diff --cached --check all exit 0; head_before == head_after (worktree unmutated)
observedCycles.convergenceReason: computeConvergenceStatus stays below CONVERGED on a non-Approved decision even at exact-HEAD alignment - the publication gate correctly refused to authorize. Acceptance criteria 11 and 20 are standing gates re-established per candidate by ADOS; they are met only once the durable review at exact HEAD reads Approved, which by construction cannot precede this candidate's own approval.

observedCycles.fullConfiguredValidation: PASS - npm test, npx tsc --noEmit, npm run build, npm run test:e2e:home-canvas, git diff --check, git diff --cached --check all exit 0; head_before == head_after (worktree unmutated)
observedCycles.convergenceReason: All four SHA legs (candidate, validated, reviewed, reviewed==validated) were aligned at exact HEAD when this completed cycle was observed, so the only conjunct holding computeConvergenceStatus below CONVERGED was the review decision, which read 'Changes Requested' while this candidate was under review. Same standing-gate reason as the row above: acceptance criteria 11 and 20 are re-established per candidate by ADOS and are met only once the durable review at exact HEAD reads Approved, which by construction cannot precede this candidate's own approval. spec148RoleAssignmentEvidence.test.ts drives the same real gate to CONVERGED for the Approved-and-aligned case over a real-SHA fixture triple (authoritative requirement 23).

shaAlignment.exactHeadInvariant: ADOS enforces candidateSha == validatedSha == reviewedSha == exact HEAD before publication: validationPlan.js isFinalValidationSatisfied (validationPolicy.js targetsMatch) at the orchestrateCommand.js final-verification stage routes a target mismatch back to fix instead of the human merge gate, and runSummary.js feeds the same derived value into computeConvergenceStatus as exactTargetMatch. spec148RoleAssignmentEvidence.test.ts cross-checks the same three durable SHAs with the same targetsMatch comparator against `git rev-parse HEAD`.
shaAlignment.enforcementProvenById: validationPlan.js isFinalValidationSatisfied + validationPolicy.js targetsMatch (production exact-HEAD gate at orchestrateCommand.js final-verification) and tools/agent-workflow/reviewConvergence.js computeConvergenceStatus; exercised by tools/agent-workflow/spec148RoleAssignmentEvidence.test.ts including stale-approval rejection, 'converges only when validated == reviewed == exact HEAD', and the durable-source candidate == validated == reviewed cross-check via targetsMatch against exact HEAD

publicationResult: Blocked until ADOS records an Approved independent Codex review with candidateSha == validatedSha == reviewedSha == exact HEAD (tools/agent-workflow/reviewConvergence.js computeConvergenceStatus == CONVERGED). This is the publication gate of the one demonstrated controlled cycle (spec148CandidatePublicationGate); push, approval and merge remain the human-only boundary. Why still Blocked, not a frozen verdict: criterion 20 is a standing per-candidate ADOS gate satisfied only when Codex approves this exact candidate at exact HEAD, and that durable Approved review by construction cannot precede this candidate's own approval - so no truthful evidence committed as part of the candidate can assert it. The gate's enforcement code is exercised over this run's own durable ADOS records and over a real-SHA fixture triple by spec148RoleAssignmentEvidence.test.ts (authoritative requirement 23), in every case, both directions, unconditionally - the fixture triple reaches CONVERGED for the Approved-and-aligned case, which proves the composition through the gate without asserting this candidate has been approved. AutonomousCompanyOperationsE2E.test.ts does not simulate this leg; it stops at the real ADOS run-level completion signal. A standing condition, not a per-candidate status snapshot.

failureVisibility.note: Authoritative requirement 18: each stage failure preserves the authoritative prior state, exposes a concise block reason, and does not silently advance / auto-approve / fabricate completion. Deterministic coverage in AutonomousCompanyOperationsE2E.test.ts (suggestion provider, acceptance, ADOS execution stage) and spec148RoleAssignmentEvidence.test.ts (reviewer unavailable, exact-HEAD mismatch).
